message:
Kitchen windows work hard: steam, splash, glare on the worktop, and usually a view of the neighbour’s fence.

Shutters can still be a great fit there… if you pick the right material and style.

We’ve put together a plain 2026 guide covering:

• Why faux wood usually beats timber or MDF by the sink
• Café-height vs full-height above the tap
• Rough fitted costs
• What we check on a Leicestershire survey

Read it here: https://shutter-envy.co.uk/kitchen-shutters-uk-buyers-guide/

Free home visit if you’d rather talk it through in your kitchen.
